title: Environment and Other Legislation Amendment (Removing Nuclear Energy Prohibitions) Bill 2022
short_title: Environment and Other Legislation Amendment (Removing Nuclear Energy Prohibitions) Bill 2022

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would remove federal legislative prohibitions on approving or authorising specified nuclear facilities, including nuclear power plants, fuel fabrication plants, enrichment plants and reprocessing facilities.
It would repeal restrictions in national environment and radiation safety laws, allowing proposals to be considered through the remaining approval and regulatory processes.

Other environmental assessment requirements, state and territory radiation protections and the Foreign Affairs Minister’s nuclear safeguards permit powers would remain, with commencement after royal assent.
changes: The radiation safety law’s express restriction on authorising construction or operation of these installations would be repealed.
Environment law provisions preventing declarations and approvals for the listed nuclear installations would be removed.
A restriction on conservation agreements relating to those nuclear installations would also be repealed.
summary.affected: Proponents seeking approval for nuclear facilities would be affected.
